title: A bill to designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 120 West Pike Street in Canonsburg, Pennsylvania, as the "Police Officer Scott Bashioum Post Office Building".
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 120 West Pike Street in Canonsburg, Pennsylvania, as the "Police Officer Scott Bashioum Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Names the Canonsburg, Pennsylvania post office building after police officer Scott Bashioum.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 120 West Pike Street in Canonsburg, Pennsylvania, as the "Police Officer Scott Bashioum Post Office Building." It is an honorary designation and does not change how the post office operates. Mail service, hours, and rules stay the same.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on March 16, 2018, when it was signed.
